items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He really gave the Basie thing another sound to work with and inspired all those cool arrangements. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. Those were the years of the Basie band.

ctx.x: And really that was the first one. And shortly after that, Sam Most, Joe Farrell, Frank Wess. I’m not quite sure of the chronology there.
He really gave the Basie thing another sound to work with and inspired all those cool arrangements.
Oh, yeah. Those were the years of the Basie band.
